lines.zh: 我踩着杂草一样的小步走
lines.en: I walk in small weedy steps
The leaves on me sway with every step

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里踩过去
lines.en: I tread through the swamp mud
My roots drag along the ground

lines.zh: 我走得慢，草倒是长得快
lines.en: I walk slowly, but the weeds grow fast
I shed leaves as I walk

lines.zh: 我把身体稍微歪成一边
lines.en: I lean my body to one side

lines.zh: 我的脚跟陷进泥里又拔出来
lines.en: My heels sink into the mud and pull free

lines.zh: 我从一丛芦苇旁走过去
lines.en: I walk past a stand of reeds

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫倒了一片小草
lines.en: My tail knocks down a patch of small weeds
I walk a circle around the puddle

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩着水声走
lines.en: I walk to the sound of water at my feet
I walk along the swamp's boundary
I go around a patch of duckweed
I stand at the edge of the swamp

lines.zh: 我身上的杂草在风里摆
lines.en: The weeds on me sway in the wind
I am sunning myself, and growing
I wait for someone to drop something
I stay still like a clump of weeds
My roots push into the mud

lines.zh: 我在听沼泽里的气泡声
lines.en: I listen to the swamp bubbles

lines.zh: 我的叶子上停了一只虫
lines.en: A bug has settled on my leaf

lines.zh: 我把一只脚提起来歇着
lines.en: I lift one foot to rest it

lines.zh: 我在数水面上有几圈涟漪
lines.en: I count the ripples on the water

lines.zh: 我的身体在往高处长一点
lines.en: My body grows a little taller

lines.zh: 我在等一只虫爬到我脸上
lines.en: I wait for a bug to crawl onto my face

lines.zh: 我把一片叶子咬下来嚼
lines.en: I bite off a leaf and chew it
Do you want to sit on my back
I am not fast, but I am steady
I must smell, do I not
You can hold the weeds on my back

lines.zh: 我吃的东西你可能不喜欢
lines.en: You probably would not like what I eat
The weeds on me are prickly
Do you not find me foul-smelling
My nose is not very good
Your shoes will pick up my mud
I have stood here all day
I have no strength to fight

lines.zh: 你身上没有沼泽的味道
lines.en: You carry no swamp smell

lines.zh: 我背上的草可以抓着上
lines.en: You can grab the weeds on my back to climb up

lines.zh: 我这种人只配待在泥里
lines.en: A thing like me belongs in the mud

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪开一点，不挡你
lines.en: I shift aside a little so as not to block you
My leaves were torn off
I lost several
It does not hurt much, I just look bad
I do not much mind that
I sink a bit into the mud

lines.zh: 这点伤对我来说不算什么
lines.en: Such a scratch means little to me
I have grown back a little
Even a body of dung can hurt.
That smell is not from the mud
My mouth holds only mud and weeds
What I eat is something else
What you hold is too clean
I am not fussy, but not that
I cannot touch your thing
That is not the smell
I am looking for something else
Yours is too dry
I do not eat clean things
Best put your thing away
I do not even want to look at it

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，草都乱了
lines.en: You hit me and my weeds went everywhere

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，掉了几片叶子
lines.en: We collided and a few leaves fell

lines.zh: 我身上的草叶被你撞掉两片。
lines.en: Two blades of the grass on my body are knocked loose by you.
I do not mind, the weeds will grow back
You knocked the weeds off me
My mud rubbed off on you

lines.zh: 我们撞一下，我滑了一下
lines.en: We bumped and I slipped
This is not worth fussing over
I am a beast of weeds
Such things happen in the swamp
I only want to find something to eat
I shake my leaves

lines.zh: 我们这一族不在意这些
lines.en: My kind do not care about such things
I only want to find something to eat
I put a leaf in front of my face
I turn and walk off

lines.zh: 这种事在沼泽里很平常
lines.en: Such things are ordinary in the swamp
I do not understand what you mean
I can get this down

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里慢慢嚼
lines.en: I stuff it in my mouth and chew slowly
I check whatever falls
This has no smell
The good things all sink into the mud
I keep this to cushion my feet
I root it into the mud with my snout
I cannot smell what this is
Something is approaching the swamp

lines.zh: 我从泥里拔出一只脚，转向那边。
lines.en: I pull one foot out of the mud and turn that way.
The weeds on me stood up once
I am getting ready to throw
This direction is bad for it
Something has entered the swamp

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面被踩碎了，我抬头。
lines.en: The swamp surface is shattered by a step; I raise my head.
My leaves are still dripping

lines.zh: 我准备了很远就能扔出去的东西
lines.en: I have something ready to throw from far off

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的东西咽下去了
lines.en: I swallow what was in my mouth
I watch it walk, leaning
My body is gathering power
It has come a little closer

lines.zh: 嘴里那团东西，我掂了掂分量。
lines.en: I weigh the lump in my mouth.
I watch it walk
Its steps are loud in the mud
I turn my body to gather power
I wait for it to near the puddle
Its direction has not changed
Something is already gathered in my mouth
I shift my weight forward
I spit a lump out

lines.zh: 我吐完自己都退了一步
lines.en: I step back after spitting
I fling that lump out
It lands exactly where I calculated
That did not knock me crooked
I nearly fell over after throwing
I bump it from the side
I withdraw and go back to my chewing
I open my mouth and shut it again
Striking while retreating, hidden by leaves.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里冒出来
lines.en: I rise out of the swamp mud
The weeds on me appear first
This swamp suits me well
First I need to find something to eat

lines.zh: 我从沼泽底的淤泥里浮上来
lines.en: I rise out of the swamp floor's silt

lines.zh: 我身上的草先露出泥面
lines.en: The weeds on me come out of the mud first
I can be ridden

lines.zh: 这里的水是褐色的，正合我意
lines.en: The water here is brown, just right for me
I lower my head to find food first

lines.zh: 沼泽、森林、黑森林我都去
lines.en: Swamp, forest, dark forest, I go to them all
I slowly find my footing in the mud
There is enough weed on my back to grip

lines.zh: 我在浅水里慢慢走了一步
lines.en: I take one slow step in the shallows
The fire burned all my weeds black

lines.zh: 爆炸把我身上的草全掀了
lines.en: The blast stripped all the weeds off me
An arrow went through my leaves

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的根发麻
lines.en: That magic numbed my roots
I still have found nothing to eat

lines.zh: 雷把我的草烧成一条线
lines.en: Lightning burned a line through my weeds
There is no mud underfoot
